about_the_game: A rags to riches simulator where you learn to build wealth from being homeless. Learn to farm, craft goods, open a business, become a CEO, and grow your brand into a billion dollar empire. Live your story, start a family, and leave a lasting legacy in a world full of untold stories.
detailed_description: A rags to riches simulator where you learn to build wealth from being homeless. Learn to farm, craft goods, open a business, become a CEO, and grow your brand into a billion dollar empire. Live your story, start a family, and leave a lasting legacy in a world full of untold stories.
name: Trade Tales Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770, 4 GB or AMD Radeon R9 270X, 4 GB or Intel Arc A580, 8 GB
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600 or AMD Ryzen 5 8400F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti, 8 GB or AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT, 12 GB
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
